essence: The ritual representation may take the form of a half-picture or a radiant image on cloth.
The measure of those two representations should be taken from the palace or from the inner sanctum.
The measurement may be determined either by the six-barley standard or by the maker's own finger measure.
The permitted dimension ranges through finger increments up to ninety-six fingers.
This stage prescribes combining those numerical factors and multiplying the result by eight nāḍīs.
